The '''Ugnaught Mechanics Union''', or '''Ugnaught Union''' for short, was a negotiating body formed by three [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] tribes&mdash;the [[Irden]], [[Botrut]], and [[Isced]]<ref name="ActionTidings1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespin1|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 1: Live From the Surface}}</ref>&mdash;to negotiate with the other guilds of [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Boss [[Ugnor]] brought the Ugnaught leaders together with [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], the founder of Cloud City, to create the Union, and Ugnor was in turn made the "[[Ufflor of Ufflors|Ufflor o' Ufflors]]," the lead negotiator for all three tribes.<ref name="ActionTidings2" />

The primary meeting location for the union was on Cloud City in the [[Mining Quarter]], but the guild also met at the [[Mechanics Union Auxiliary Meeting Hall]] on the [[Ugnaught Surface/Legends|Ugnaught Surface]].<ref name="ActionTidings2" />
